scope: Initial, non-exhaustive inventory of major company groups, publishers, retailers, subscription services and library platforms relevant to books.
grain: One named company group or consumer/service brand per row; rows are not necessarily independent legal companies.
quantity_status: No subscriber counts, readers, loans, sales, revenues or market shares were extracted into this register.
interpretation: Public reporting documented identifies an official corporate/financial reporting source; it does not assert availability of comparable book-format metrics.
Public service information documented identifies primary service/product evidence; it does not assert an accessible historical quantitative series.
Formats describe documented book businesses. They do not imply every format is offered in every country.
Geographic scope is a qualitative official-source description. It is not a verified complete country-by-company launch matrix.
Do not aggregate parent and child rows, publisher and retailer sales, library loans, or different subscription definitions.
Blank parent_company means no separate controlling parent was entered, either for a top-level group or because a controlling parent was not verified. It does not imply independence.
Current ownership review is anchored to dated official ownership announcements and current service/company descriptions; it is not a legal corporate register.
